description: มุน 2026-08-03 (ฟีม, Figma menu 461:3224): the v2 bottom navigation. ROOT: there were TWO divergent 'shared' navs — v2-shell/Menubar (icons, NO Mate AI, 244px floating pill, no safe-area, 1 state) on service/coming-soon/compat-form/compat-recent/shop, and v2-home/CalendarMenu (Mate AI, no icons, 368px full-width, safe-area, 4 states) on home + the whole calendar flow. Nobody hard-coded a nav per page; the defect is two shared components with no single source of truth. THE BUG-CLASS THIS ANCHOR OWNS — CONTENT CLIPPED INSIDE A `position: fixed` LAYER: when the nav is wider than the screen it is clipped, but document.scrollWidth DOES NOT GROW, so every page-level overflow-x assertion in this repo reported CLEAN while the user saw 'น้าหลัก' (the ห cut off) and half a Mate AI button. Measured: CalendarMenu needed a fixed 368px (tabs pinned to w-[58px] while the CTA slot already used min-w-0 flex-1) → clipped 4px/side @360 and 24px/side @320; Menubar's 244px fit, but ADDING Mate AI (ฟีม: 'ทุกหน้า') widens it to ~332 and would have introduced the same fault, so both bars were made shrinkable and the tab type steps down (14 → 12 <384 → 11 <340) so NO LABEL IS EVER TRUNCATED (measured: 'หน้าหลัก' is 49.8px @14 but only ~40px/tab is available @320). Mate AI extracted to ONE shared component (v2-shell/MateAIButton) rather than copied, and its skin was INVERTED vs Figma — shipped as a teal→purple gradient FILL with a solid label; the node has a LIME #E1FF00 fill with a blue→magenta (#294DA7→#D036A9) GRADIENT LABEL, border #EDCCD7. SCOPE GUARDS (both directions): menu state 'form' (save sheet) has NO Mate AI by Figma design, and the compat RESULT screen has NO bottom menu at all (frame 636:18819 ends empty — ฟีม-ruled) — so 'ทุกหน้า' must NOT be applied blindly; mut-mate-on-form guards that opposite error. VERIFY-THE-INSTRUMENT (caught live): the first version of the probe measured only nav.children and mut-nav-fixed-width did NOT trip, because pinned tabs overflow INSIDE the pill without moving the nav box — the probe now unions the LEAF boxes (tabs + Mate AI) and flags any container clipping its own content. Teeth-proven (run-nav-consistency.ts, 22/22): mut-nav-fixed-width, mut-page-missing-nav, mut-mate-on-form — all CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/layout (measured element boxes + label truncation + computed skin) across 8 widths 320-430 x 4 states x 5 routes. NOT-A-REGRESSION note: run-shared-topbar / run-service-hub fail with 'ReferenceError: React is not defined' on main too (pre-existing, unrelated). Did NOT touch pages/matching or constants/api/api-user-matching (git diff 0). PR2 (2026-08-03, #164): the two navs are now ONE — v2-shell/Menubar holds the single implementation with all four states plus the REAL Figma tab icons (exported from Menubar instance 469:3671, painted with currentColor so active/inactive need one class not two icon sets), and v2-home/CalendarMenu is a thin forwarder so goo's menu-state contract + CalendarShell + V2HomeScreen + menu-preview compile untouched. home gains the icon row it never had — the intended Figma-fidelity change of PR2, not a regression. run-nav-consistency stays 22/22 with all 3 teeth biting after the merge.
